Class AdminDashboardController

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.controllers.admin.AdminDashboardController
public class AdminDashboardController extends Object
Task 3 – Admin Portal shell.

The dashboard owns navigation, the unread-notification badge and session guarding. Each section is implemented in its own pane class so the business screens stay readable and independently testable.
